How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You had to choose courses a week before the courses started. The registration opened for everyone and people had to choose more courses than they needed because there was this weird waiting list system. If you really want a course, you have to go to classes during the first week to ask the teachers if they can add you to the course.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You could mail the people at the international office. But they were pretty stressed as everyone mailed during the first week, so they didn't really answer.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: not very. Had to completely change my learning agreement.
